mapper.insert: INSERT INTO file_metadata (id, original_name, file_size, content_type, sha256, storage_path, storage_type, parent_id, is_directory, current_version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{originalName}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{sha256}, #{storagePath}, #{storageType}, #{parentId}, #{isDirectory}, #{currentVersion}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE file_metadata SET original_name = #{originalName}, file_size = #{fileSize}, content_type = #{contentType}, sha256 = #{sha256}, storage_path = #{storagePath}, current_version = #{currentVersion}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM file_metadata WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} ORDER BY is_directory DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM file_metadata WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_directory = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM file_metadata WHERE is_directory = false ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT count(*) FROM file_metadata WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND is_directory = false
